evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
The sweep is saved notebook output, not a new model fit or reproduction.
nonzero_loading_fraction counts entries of the 20-by-1000 loading matrix; 0.0705 does not mean 7.05 percent of unique genes. At alpha7, 810 of 1000 genes remain selected.
Original standalone projection images and the filtered 20-component sweep are distinct analyses; do not equate their settings.
Aggregate visualizations only; no patient identifiers, individual gene-expression rows or clinical validation collected.
The saved error/loading plot has an author-annotated elbow at alpha7; that annotation is not an independently established optimal choice.
